verdict: Pricing and payment computation are sound; SEC-01 allows direct field tampering on the booking record

client_supplied_money.evidence: CreateCampaignBookingUseCase lines 163-216 compute authoritativeSubtotal/Discount/Final from CampaignPricingService and store those. The client payload's subtotal, discount_amount and final_amount are documented as informational only and are never stored or charged.
CreatePaymentOrderUseCase returns Money::toPaise($payment->amount) from the persisted Payment record; no amount is accepted from the request.

PaymentController::verify validates only razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id and razorpay_signature. No amount field exists on the request, so there is no tampering vector, and the Razorpay signature binds order_id to payment_id.

SEC-01. 'price' => 'sometimes|numeric|min:0' and 'status' => 'sometimes|string' are accepted and written straight through by RescheduleBookingUseCase line 135. A user without bookings.edit can set both.

integrity_checks_present: Authoritative repricing at booking time (reconciles stale recommendations).
Razorpay signature verification via the official SDK utility.
Per-screen even split and unit_price arithmetic preserved.
Revenue distribution resolved server-side by RevenueSplitResolverService.

integrity_checks_absent.gap: no cross-check of the settled amount against the order amount at verification time
integrity_checks_absent.rationale: Currently mitigated by Razorpay's guarantee that a payment belongs to its order and by the signature binding. A defensive amount assertion would be cheap hardening.

integrity_checks_absent.gap: status is an unconstrained string on booking update
'price' => 'min:0' with no upper bound or relation to the pricing engine

accepted_debt: Reschedule does not reprice or redistribute revenue. This changes financial output, so it is recorded rather than fixed.
Loyalty/referral side effects execute in Booking model events inside the caller's transaction.
immutability: Payment and settlement rows are updated in place by design (status transitions), so there is no append-only financial ledger guarantee. 19 financial status-transition sites were identified as running outside an explicit DB::transaction; the highest-value ones are CommissionService:99 (paid), RefundService:86 (refunded) and ReferralTrackingService:183/208 (cancelled/refunded).
blocked: No financial code was modified in Phase 0.16.
